concept: Inference Metrics Framework: TTFT TPS and Memory Profiling
summary: Source-anchored research for Inference Metrics Framework: TTFT TPS and Memory Profiling. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Time to First Token (TTFT) is compute-bound, determined by prompt batch parallel FLOPs on GPU compute cores, whereas auto-regressive token generation (TPS) is memory bandwidth-bound. (high confidence)

Measuring peak VRAM consumption requires tracking resident set size (RSS), active Metal wired memory allocations, and discrete GPU allocated VRAM during maximum prompt length ingestion. (high confidence)

Reporting mean tokens per second without measuring inter-token latency variance masks stutter caused by periodic garbage collection, dynamic KV cache reallocation, and memory compaction. (high confidence)
Automated evaluation pipelines must record thermal throttling states and host bus bandwidth saturation alongside inference latency to ensure benchmark reproducibility. (high confidence)
